给 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** 用的「一轮跑完就弹系统通知」插件。上游 [`omdsh-dev/dsh-notification`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-notification) 只覆盖 0.1.1 / 0.1.2 的客户端布局，这个包是它的 0.2.x 移植版。

## 它做什么

- Host 半边注册一个 `notification` 会话投影：折叠每个会话的最后一次 `turn/end`，得到 `{ turn, reason, body, tools }`；再提供一个 `POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify` 路由，用 WinRT 真正把 toast 弹出来。
- Client 半边盯住 `ctx.sessions.list` 里这个投影的 `turn` 单调上升，决定这一轮要不要提醒（原因过滤、后台限制、总开关）；**桌面壳里把内容 POST 给宿主去弹，浏览器里才用页面自己的 `Notification`**。正文是该轮最后一段助手回复（Host 侧截到 400 字符，Client 侧再按设置截一次）。
- 设置页在 **设置 → 完成提醒**：总开关、按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒、通知常驻、正文长度、权限状态、发测试通知。

投影是纯函数，Host 侧只注册、不碰会话日志以外的任何东西；Client 侧只用公开的 `sessions.list` 快照和 `settings.section` 槽位。

## 桌面端：权限 ≠ 能够显示

两件事必须分开看，实测都踩过：

**1. 权限。** 桌面壳（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` 0.2.1-rc.2）给主窗口装的权限处理器，对**非 media** 权限是 `callback(true)` / `check → true`（见 `installMicrophonePermissions`）；被一律拒掉的是第三方登录窗口和 browser-use 的独立 partition。所以主窗口里 `Notification.permission` 实测就是 `granted`，不需要主进程加 IPC。

**2. Windows 的 toast 呈现。** 权限给了、`new Notification()` 也返回成功，**照样可能一个都不显示**，而且是两层原因叠在一起：

- **AUMID 没人注册。** Electron 在 Windows 上把 renderer 的通知按 AppUserModelID 归属；桌面壳的 `main.js` 里 `setAppUserModelId` 出现次数是 **0**，Chromium 退回默认值 `electron.app.DeepSeek Harness`，而开始菜单快捷方式的 `System.AppUserModelID` 是空串 —— 这个 AUMID 指向不到任何已注册应用。Windows 照样记账（`HKCU\...\Notifications\Settings\electron.app.DeepSeek Harness` 的 `LastNotificationAddedTime` 会更新）但**静默丢弃 toast**，通知中心里连留底都没有。
- **即使 AUMID 补齐了，Chromium 这条 presenter 仍然不放行。** 同一个 AUMID 下用 WinRT 直接发就能显示，页面里 `new Notification()` 发就还是不显示。所以桌面端不让页面发，改成页面 POST 给宿主、宿主用 WinRT 发（`POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify`）。

两步都做上才算通：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\fix-toast-aumid.ps1
# 撤销：加 -Remove
```

它写两个键，都不碰壳、不碰 asar、不碰快捷方式：

- `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\<AUMID>`（DisplayName + IconUri）—— 让 Windows 认这个 AUMID。
- `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshnotify`（URL Protocol + handler）—— **点通知能把窗口拉回前台**。

### 点通知回到前台

toast 带 `activationType="protocol" launch="dshnotify:focus"`，点它时 Windows 跑上面注册的 handler，把 `DeepSeek Harness` 的主窗口提到前台。抢前台要绕开 Windows 的前台锁，所以是三级降级、每级都校验：

1. `AttachThreadInput` 借前台线程的输入队列 → `BringWindowToTop` → `SetForegroundWindow`
2. `SwitchToThisWindow`
3. `SW_MINIMIZE` → `SW_RESTORE`（还原的窗口会拿到激活权）→ 再 `SetForegroundWindow`

**handler 不能闪黑框。** 控制台程序（`powershell.exe`）在能隐藏自己之前就已经被加载器创建了控制台窗口，所以 `-WindowStyle Hidden` 也挡不住闪一下。因此：

- 有 C# 编译器时，`fix-toast-aumid.ps1` 把 `scripts/focus-dsh.cs` 编成 **`scripts/focus-dsh.exe`**（`/target:winexe` = GUI 子系统，压根没有控制台），协议直接指向它；
- 没有编译器时退到 **`wscript.exe`**（GUI 宿主）跑 `scripts/focus.ps1` 的隐藏 PowerShell —— 同样不闪。

两个产物都在 `.gitignore` 里（构建物不入库），换机器装的时候由注册脚本现编。

为什么不用 `activationType="foreground"`：那需要给 AUMID 注册一个 `ToastActivatorCLSID` COM 服务器（还要处理 `-ToastActivated` 命令行），而桌面壳不提供；协议激活只需要一个 HKCU 注册表项。

handler 里写的是**本 checkout 的绝对路径**，所以挪动插件目录后要重跑一次 `fix-toast-aumid.ps1`。

> **两个 PowerShell 坑（都实测踩过，都会静默失败）**
>
> 1. `[Type]::Static($x).Method()` 这种**在静态方法结果上继续调方法**的写法，Windows PowerShell 5.1 直接解析失败；配上 `stdio: 'ignore'` 就是"退出码 0、什么也没发生"。必须拆成 `$notifier = [Type]::Static($x)` 然后 `$notifier.Method()`。宿主侧现在会收集子进程 stdout/stderr 并写进 trace（`host-notify-result`），失败不再无声。
> 2. `powershell -File` 执行**无 BOM 的 UTF-8** 脚本会按 GBK 解析，中文字面量变成"锟斤拷"。所以 `scripts/toast.ps1` 是纯 ASCII，用户可见文本一律通过 UTF-8 JSON 文件传进去。

## 已知边界

- 不提醒「等你审批 / 等你回答」这类挂起交互（原因见上）。
- 页面必须在跑：判定发生在页面里，页面关了就没有；桌面端只是把"弹"这一步交给宿主。
- `turn/end` 的 `forked` / `interrupted` 也会推进投影的 `turn`（这样客户端去重不会漏轮），但默认只在 `completed` / `error` 上弹。
- 诊断用：Host 半边注册了 `GET/POST/DELETE /dsh-notification-desktop/trace`，客户端把每次闸门判断 POST 进去。排查"为什么不弹"直接 `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-notification-desktop/trace` 就能看到 `apply` / `seed` / `tick` / `skip` / `fire` / `deliver` / `host-notify` / `host-notify-result` 记录 —— 一次真实排查就是靠这条链定位到上面两个坑的。

        hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : null,
      })

      // A reconnect (sleep, unlock, WS reset) rebuilds the session list before
      // the projections hydrate. Baselining those rows at "turn 0" made every
      // session look freshly completed once its history arrived, which fired a
      // toast per session on every unlock. Entries therefore carry whether the
      // projection was present when they were recorded, and a seed opens a
      // short window in which nothing may fire at all.
      const GRACE_MS = 5000
      let graceUntil = 0

      const seed = () => {
        const state = list.getSnapshot()
        observed.clear()
        if (state === undefined || !Array.isArray(state.ids)) return
        for (const id of state.ids) {
          const row = state.byId?.[id]
          const projection = row?.projectionValues?.notification
          observed.set(id, {
            turn: turnOf(row),
            hydrated: projection !== undefined && projection !== null,
            // Rows present at seed time may carry history behind them; a row
            // that shows up later is a session this page watched from birth.
            fromSeed: true,
          })
        }
        graceUntil = Date.now() + GRACE_MS
        report({ kind: 'seed', phase: state.phase, ids: state.ids.length, baselines: [...observed.entries()] })
      }

      const fire = (api, row, projection, settings) => {
        const title = t(REASON_TITLE[projection.reason] ?? 'titleCompleted')
        const limit = settings.bodyChars
        const body = clampBody(projection.body, limit) || t('emptyBody')
        const subtitle = sessionTitleOf(row, t)
        const tag = tagOf(row.id, projection.turn)
        const text = subtitle === '' ? body : `${subtitle}\n${body}`
        const deliver = () => {
          if (isDesktopShell()) {
            // On the desktop shell Chromium's Windows presenter reports success
            // and Windows drops the toast, so the host shows it instead.
            pushToast({ title, body: text, tag, turn: projection.turn })
            report({ kind: 'deliver', ok: true, via: 'host', tag, title, turn: projection.turn })
            return
          }
          const result = show(api, title, text, tag, settings.requireInteraction)
          report({
            kind: 'deliver',
            ok: result.ok,
            via: 'notification',
            message: result.ok ? '' : result.message,
            tag,
            title,
            turn: projection.turn,
          })
          if (!result.ok) console.error(`[dsh-notification-desktop] notification failed: ${result.message}`)
        }
        if (isDesktopShell()) {
          deliver()
          return
        }
        if (api.permission === 'granted') deliver()
        else if (api.permission === 'default') {
          api.requestPermission().then(status => {
            report({ kind: 'permission-request', status })
            if (status === 'granted') deliver()
          })

          report({ kind: 'deliver', ok: false, message: `permission=${api.permission}`, turn: projection.turn })
        }

        const state = list.getSnapshot()
        if (state === undefined || !Array.isArray(state.ids)) return
        ticks += 1
        const settings = store.get()
        const api = notificationApi()
        const changed = []
        for (const id of state.ids) {
          const row = state.byId?.[id]
          if (row === undefined || row === null) continue
          const projection = row.projectionValues?.notification
          const hydrated = projection !== undefined && projection !== null
          const turn = turnOf(row)
          const previous = observed.get(id)
          if (!hydrated) {
            // A missing projection is a transient resync state. It must never
            // overwrite a known baseline with turn 0, or the history that comes
            // back would look like a completion.
            if (previous === undefined) observed.set(id, { turn, hydrated: false, fromSeed: false })
            continue
          }
          observed.set(id, { turn, hydrated: true, fromSeed: false })
          const before = previous === undefined ? undefined : previous.turn
          if (before !== undefined && turn !== before) changed.push({ id, from: before, to: turn })
          if (previous === undefined) continue
          // A row that was seeded without its projection only *learns* its turn
          // when history hydrates: that is not a completion. A session born
          // after the seed is new, so its first completion still notifies.
          if (previous.fromSeed && !previous.hydrated) continue
          if (turn <= before) continue
          if (Date.now() < graceUntil) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'resync-grace' })
            continue
          }
          if (!settings.enabled) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'disabled' })
            continue
          }
          if (api === undefined && !isDesktopShell()) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'no-api' })
            continue
          }
          if (projection === undefined || projection === null) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'no-projection' })
            continue
          }
          const flag = REASON_FLAG[projection.reason]
          if (flag === undefined) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'reason-not-mapped', reason: projection.reason })
            continue
          }
          if (settings[flag] !== true) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'reason-off', reason: projection.reason })
            continue
          }
          if (settings.backgroundOnly && !document.hidden && isMainView(row)) {
            report({ kind: 'skip', id, turn, previous: before, skip: 'background-only', hidden: document.hidden, main: isMainView(row) })
            continue
          }
          report({
            kind: 'fire',
            id,
            turn,
            previous: before,
            reason: projection.reason,
            hidden: document.hidden,
            main: isMainView(row),
            permission: api === undefined ? 'no-api' : api.permission,
          })
          fire(api, row, projection, settings)
        }
        // Bounded observation: the first few list updates plus every turn
        // change. This is what tells a silent plugin whether the list moves at
        // all and whether the rows carry the projection key.
        if (ticks <= 4 || changed.length > 0) {
          report({
            kind: 'tick',
            n: ticks,
            phase: state.phase,
            ids: state.ids.length,
            changed,
            hidden: typeof document === 'undefined' ? null : document.hidden,
            rows: state.ids.slice(0, 3).map(id => {
              const row = state.byId?.[id]
              return {
                id: String(id).slice(-8),
                keys: Object.keys(row?.projectionValues ?? {}),
                turn: turnOf(row),
                main: isMainView(row),
              }
            }),
          })
        }
        const live = new Set(state.ids)
        for (const id of [...observed.keys()]) if (!live.has(id)) observed.delete(id)
      }

      seed()
      const offList = list.subscribe(run)
      const offReset =
        typeof ctx.on === 'function'
          ? ctx.on('connection/reset', () => {
              seed()
            })
          : () => {}
      return () => {
        offList()
        if (typeof offReset === 'function') offReset()
      }

      return h(

        h('input', { type: 'checkbox', checked: checked === true, onChange: event => onChange(event.target.checked) }),

      const [permission, setPermission] = useState(currentPermission)
      const [note, setNote] = useState('')

      useEffect(() => store.subscribe(() => setSettings(store.get())), [store])

        [store],

        const api = notificationApi()
        if (api === undefined) {

        Promise.resolve(api.requestPermission()).then(status => {

        { className: 'dsh-ntf-root' },
        h('style', null, STYLE),
        h('p', { className: 'dsh-ntf-desc' }, t('desc')),
        h(

          { className: 'dsh-ntf-group' },

            { className: 'dsh-ntf-actions' },
            h(

                onClick: requestPermission,

              },
              t('request'),

            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'dsh-ntf-btn', onClick: sendTest }, t('test')),
            h(

          h('span', { className: 'dsh-ntf-hint' }, t('aumidHint')),

        h(
          'div',
          { className: 'dsh-ntf-group' },
          h('div', { className: 'dsh-ntf-legend' }, t('reasonTitle')),
          reasonRow('notifyCompleted', 'reasonCompleted'),
          reasonRow('notifyError', 'reasonError'),
          reasonRow('notifyAborted', 'reasonAborted'),
          reasonRow('notifyBlocked', 'reasonBlocked'),
          reasonRow('notifyMaxTokens', 'reasonMaxTokens'),
        ),
        h(
          'div',
          { className: 'dsh-ntf-group' },
          h('div', { className: 'dsh-ntf-legend' }, t('behaviorTitle')),
          h(CheckRow, {
            checked: settings.backgroundOnly === true,
            onChange: value => update({ backgroundOnly: value }),
            label: t('backgroundOnly'),
            hint: t('backgroundOnlyHint'),
          }),
          h(CheckRow, {
            checked: settings.requireInteraction === true,
            onChange: value => update({ requireInteraction: value }),
            label: t('requireInteraction'),
          }),
          h(
            'label',
            { className: 'dsh-ntf-row' },
            h(
              'span',
              { className: 'dsh-ntf-row-main' },
              h('span', null, t('bodyChars')),
              h('input', {

                type: 'number',

                value: settings.bodyChars,
                onChange: event => {
                  const next = Number(event.target.value)
                  if (Number.isFinite(next)) update({ bodyChars: Math.min(400, Math.max(20, Math.round(next))) })
                },
              }),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      )
    }

    // ─── plugin body ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS)
      const store = createStore()

      console.info(`[dsh-notification-desktop] loaded (permission=${currentPermission()})`)

            id: 'notification',
            order: 60,
            label: () => t('nav'),
            inject: () => ({ t, store }),
          },
          Section,
        ),
      )
    }

$xmlText = "<toast launch='dshnotify:focus' activationType='protocol' duration='long'><visual><binding template='ToastGeneric'><text>$title</text><text>$body</text></binding></visual></toast>"
